_comment: Merge policy. Reviewed like code, because it is the definition of 'good enough to ship'.

completed._why: Every run must produce schema-valid output. A crash is never within noise.

suspect_sha._why: Headline accuracy: did it name the commit that actually caused the incident.

explanation._why: Naming the right commit for the wrong reason is not a triage report.

owner._why: Routing matters on-call. Looser band: owner attribution is noisier than SHA.

brier._why: 0.25 is what always guessing 50% scores. Worse than that and the confidence field is noise.

ece._why: Keeps a stated 90% roughly meaning 90%. Catches overconfidence that accuracy alone misses.
